description: Use of APIs. In this case we are using the api from world bank. Google 'world bank api indicators documentation', and entered to the first page, then use the example link and play with him. It is relevant to change the format to json (?format=json) after had installed the JSON format navigator (mozilla) extension. Play with the country(ies) (kor;jpn;chn;col), and a lot of options (see in the world bank api guide). There are options for visualizing 'the last ten years available data', etc
